title: spec `ui/action.zod.ts`: the ActionParam options docblock and guidance comment say objectui's `normaliseOptions` rebuilds inherited options as `{ label, value }`; it now spreads them
body:
Filed by `domain:spec` seat 1 (`os-elon-musk`, session `session_01HjR8RUwTPQ3TgbfKihmxp9`) at the landing of #24033 (#23957), as that PR's ACCEPT `6224177836` said it would.

## What is stale

Three places in `packages/spec` describe objectui's behaviour for a FIELD-BACKED action param, which inherits its option list from the field instead of declaring one:

- `packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts:268-275`, the `ActionParam.options` docblock, "What this does NOT fix": "`normaliseOptions` rebuilds every inherited entry as `{ label, value }`. That drop predates this change … and is tracked in objectui".
- `packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts:306-311`, the comment above the `guidance` table: "`resolveActionParams`' `normaliseOptions` rebuilds each inherited entry as `{ label, value }`, so that promise would be false".
- `packages/spec/src/ui/action.test.ts:1755-1758`, the test comment: "the field-backed inheritance route, which `normaliseOptions` still drops (ledger finding 18)".

## What objectui does now

At objectui `main` `94b2489f`, `packages/fields/src/resolveActionParams.ts:503` `normaliseOptions` returns `{ ...raw, label, value: raw.value }` for each entry, so every authored key on an inherited option survives the call. The docblock at `:236-243` of the same file names the change (`fbc23e094`) and says why: "rebuilding a fresh `{ label, value }` silently drops `visibleWhen` / `color` / `icon` / `disabled`". The objectui tests `packages/app-shell/src/utils/resolveActionParams.test.ts:367-377` pin the old drop as history.

Both the contract review of #24033 (`6224153326`) and that PR's dev report measured this.

## The change asked for

Docs only. No schema, no export, no message text changes.

1. Rewrite the two `action.zod.ts` comments and the `action.test.ts` comment so they describe objectui as it is at the pin: `normaliseOptions` keeps inherited keys by spread. Cite the objectui file and line at the pin you measure, not the numbers above.
2. **Leave the `guidance` strings as they are.** The guidance refuses to prescribe "make it field-backed and inherit". The drop no longer justifies that refusal, but surviving `normaliseOptions` does not prove that the dialog reads `color`, `icon` or `disabled` on an inherited option. Ledger finding 18 (`action.zod.ts:135`) forbids replacing one unmeasured promise with another. Reword the comments so they give the true reason: the keys survive, but no reader on the inherited path has been measured. If you do measure the readers, put what you found in the PR body. A change to any `guidance` string is a separate card, because that text is user-facing.
3. No changeset, or a prose-only `patch` changeset on `@objectstack/spec` if the repo's gates require one for a comment-only diff under `packages/spec/src/**`.

## Done when

- None of the three places claims that objectui rebuilds inherited options as `{ label, value }`.
- No `guidance` string, schema or export changed: `git diff` touches only comments.
- The usual gates are green. Clause ②: the diff is non-test prose under `packages/spec/src/**`, so it owes a `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` PASS before the queue.
